高朋滿座#170粵
programme.desc: 麗聽到亨的表白，大驚逃走，向眾人表示她要勇敢地根治與亨的問題。麗提出以「預習拍拖」之法，令她和亨之間熟習拍拖後的生活。原來高麗此舉的目的是令亨利死心，因此她提出多番無理要求，並以分手威脅要亨利完成。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#15粵普PG
programme.desc: 洪七公身體逐漸虛弱，決定將幫主之位傳給黃蓉…黃蓉想出計謀，讓歐陽克被巨石壓住；此時歐陽鋒和郭靖來到島上，歐陽鋒以洪七公作威脅，要郭靖和黃蓉救歐陽克…歐陽克在生死關頭向歐陽鋒求證一個關於自己身世的聽聞…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽煮排骨確有一手，「陳皮骨」有何秘訣？黑蒜近年成為養生食物新寵，生吃口感微酸且甜，加入蜜豆炒帶子最適合。學習「粟米牛奶濃湯」製法外，且看六號示範「極速粟米起粒法」。肥媽還炮製甜品「黃糖肉桂蝴蝶酥」。

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG AI 點只科技股粵
programme.desc: 《才駿HASHTAG》匯聚各界精英，每周與您分享名家視角、更新市場焦點熱話。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 斑禿俗稱「鬼剃頭」，其實是一種跟免疫系統相關的脫髮？有指壓力是成因之一，專科醫生有甚麼看法？斑禿與一般脫髮如何分辨？醫生細說服用免疫調節藥物等醫治方法，也提到治療過程需時。貝安琪攜同九歲兒子受訪，她既是演員也是瑜伽導師，怎樣兼顧兩項工作，並同時好好照顧兒子？又為何堅持讓兒子入讀本地學校？安琪還即席教芝齡試做幾個專業的初階瑜伽動作，觀眾亦可修習。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐奉上消暑美食「碗仔素翅冬瓜盅」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 打卡是許多人旅遊的主要目的，主持們往珠海的北山會館古建築打卡之餘，還喝涼茶、雞尾酒，更深入區內一試重慶火鍋，刺激！深圳亦有攝影勝地，歡迎各少女打卡朝聖，場地還提供下午茶餐，也可餵餵羊駝。轉進商場，品嚐海南風味，燒雞皮竟可以脆如薯片？在香港，堅尼地城也有不少打卡點，夜了不妨吃煲仔飯及即蒸點心醫肚，指定時段七折供應！銅鑼灣火鍋店亦有型格壁畫讓顧客自拍，身為吃貨當然要享用龍蝦冬蔭功湯底，打個着數邊爐。

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG AI 點只科技股粵
programme.desc: 《才駿HASHTAG》匯聚各界精英，每周與您分享名家視角、更新市場焦點熱話。

programme.title: 天梯#1粵
programme.desc: 苗天與妻子顧新月在深山隱居，為了方便妻子上下山，花四十年親手開鑿數千級的「愛情天梯」。一九三四年，苗天領導村民種植名貴藥材，把藥材運到廣州售賣。新月兒子思行因門牙脫落久未長出新牙，被同學取笑不肯上學。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 佐佐木爺爺受傷，小丸子叫來爸爸幫忙，結果收到特級酒作為謝禮，為了喝到好酒，爸爸也變得勤快起來。小丸子因為不想在體育課上跑步，於是跳起祈雨舞，食髓知味的她居然為測驗要求爸爸戒酒。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 芭菲精靈的朋友火箭菜姐姐，首次到來協助管理零食廠，四位零食小兵隨即聽從其指令，比拼「廠長話」遊戲。曲奇隊的男生一直望着旁邊，動作稍有遲疑，就成為第一個被淘汰之人……火箭菜姐姐要求兩隊分別在果園內摘取五個指定水果，薯片隊兩名女兵分工清晰，不足一分鐘就過關！曲奇小兵略有緊張，拿完水果便想折返起點？最後的任務是運送雪糕球走過「溶化之橋」，有小兵起步不久就把雪糕球弄跌了，看來需要更多打氣聲和鼓勵。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 果Jam叔叔說將會前往雪童子山，對此深感興趣的咖哩包超人決定先行一步。因為麵粉用光，果Jam叔叔拜託火車頭人前往山羊叔叔的住處領取麵粉。細菌人認為這是打擊麵包超人的好機會，於是出手阻止。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
programme.desc: 體外受精及胚胎移植(IVF)，俗稱試管嬰兒，療程涉及從女士的卵巢中抽取卵子，讓精子和卵子在體外受精結合，培養成胚胎後再移植回女士的子宮內。這種受孕治療最新發展如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 2026香港小姐 敢．至完美粵 及 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵
programme.desc: 《中年好聲音4》登峯之戰結束後，台前幕後出席慶功宴，許濤主席、曾志偉親臨表揚眾人；曾生更大讚車婉婉當主持越見大將之風。此外，「三料」冠軍尹景順舉行慶祝活動，跟粉絲一同分享奪冠喜悅，並再次感謝大家支持。上集報道的連鎖美容店不良銷售事件，坊間其實還有不少美容店使用類似的銷售手法。攝製隊人員再次喬裝深入調查，為觀眾揭露更多美容店不良銷售手段。另會介紹政府部門與公共設施如何引入AI技術，提升能源效益。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#12粵
programme.desc: 嘉驄遲遲未成家立室，嘉冰不禁憂心，更夢見先父責成她催促嘉驄早日成婚、繼後香燈。為此，嘉冰加緊為嘉驄物色對象，更設下連串考驗，終於找到理想人選Becca。Becca不但不抗拒嘉驄，更對他表現進取。嘉驄因情路屢受挫折而猶疑不決，聽從「開心小棧」住客楊光的建議後，遂與Becca嘗試約會，豈料對方竟有意想不到的「安排」……其後，Becca到訪萬里家中，親自為眾人下廚，儼然以家人自居，卻逐漸露出真本性……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#17粵
programme.desc: 幸如等人因遇上突發狀況，失去向床品公司匯報的機會。眾人轉而利用網絡力量，終成功得到床品公司這個廣告客戶。家謙超額完成業績，不料啟榮交出更亮眼成績，兄弟競爭愈發激烈。守業為保工作，再次情緒勒索美淇，美淇在問責大會上助他逃過一劫。及後，其昌信心十足地匯報賢淑薈萃活動的宣傳意念……終於來到繼威、雪文婚禮當天。幸如盛裝出席，要見證雪文與繼威踏入不幸婚姻生活的起點。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 紀封徹夜照料生病的蜜語，秀梅藉探望之名帶寄舟上門。寄舟邀蜜語赴港看展覽，後在酒吧欲吻她，蜜語躲開。Marcos派對上，紀封瞥見寄舟約見訊息，遂邀蜜語共舞試探。紀封獨自買醉，借著酒勁到蜜語樓下卻見她剛回宿舍…

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Slim益生菌呈獻：南美潮什麼2粵
programme.desc: 伊莎貝拉島的獨特火山岩地形為生物提供優良的棲息環境，芷珮大清早就「船駁船」登島探索，盡情擁抱自然生態。穿過「紅樹林隧道」，躍進湖中玩浮潛，和魚兒、海龜暢泳，逾百隻魔鬼魚湧現一幕更份外震撼！漫步自然保護區，跟鬣蜥打招呼，窺探由火山活動形成的熔岩管，內裡也能找到生物蹤影？捕捉海獅群上岸休息時刻，再近距離觀察「明星級島民」藍腳鰹鳥，芷珮出海途中，更幸運地遇見企鵝！此外，這集帶來酒店情報、乘小型飛機貼士。

programme.desc: 小慧無法讓程凱及澤雨和好，一場工廈小火卻令他們冰釋前嫌。明晞為內幕交易案向松蔭求助，松蔭反勸明晞離婚，認為天生不值得她犧牲。眼看形勢不利，天生將主席之位讓予明晞，同時增設四名新董事。明晞處處受董事掣肘，對松蔭之言更認同。松蔭病危，臨終託付明晞入主天蔭協助澤雨，明晞含淚答應。松蔭葬禮上，定垚陪伴澤雨，二人感情默默滋長。澤雨接納明晞提議，用計踢走礙事董事，成為天蔭新任主席。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《中年好聲音4》登峯之戰結束後，台前幕後出席慶功宴，許濤主席、曾志偉親臨表揚眾人；曾生更大讚車婉婉當主持越見大將之風。此外，「三料」冠軍尹景順舉行慶祝活動，跟粉絲一同分享奪冠喜悅，並再次感謝大家支持。上集報道的連鎖美容店不良銷售事件，坊間其實還有不少美容店使用類似的銷售手法。攝製隊人員再次喬裝深入調查，為觀眾揭露更多美容店不良銷售手段。另會介紹政府部門與公共設施如何引入AI技術，提升能源效益。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 斑禿俗稱「鬼剃頭」，其實是一種跟免疫系統相關的脫髮？有指壓力是成因之一，專科醫生有甚麼看法？斑禿與一般脫髮如何分辨？醫生細說服用免疫調節藥物等醫治方法，也提到治療過程需時。貝安琪攜同九歲兒子受訪，她既是演員也是瑜伽導師，怎樣兼顧兩項工作，並同時好好照顧兒子？又為何堅持讓兒子入讀本地學校？安琪還即席教芝齡試做幾個專業的初階瑜伽動作，觀眾亦可修習。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐奉上消暑美食「碗仔素翅冬瓜盅」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 打卡是許多人旅遊的主要目的，主持們往珠海的北山會館古建築打卡之餘，還喝涼茶、雞尾酒，更深入區內一試重慶火鍋，刺激！深圳亦有攝影勝地，歡迎各少女打卡朝聖，場地還提供下午茶餐，也可餵餵羊駝。轉進商場，品嚐海南風味，燒雞皮竟可以脆如薯片？在香港，堅尼地城也有不少打卡點，夜了不妨吃煲仔飯及即蒸點心醫肚，指定時段七折供應！銅鑼灣火鍋店亦有型格壁畫讓顧客自拍，身為吃貨當然要享用龍蝦冬蔭功湯底，打個着數邊爐。

programme.title: 天梯#1粵
programme.desc: 苗天與妻子顧新月在深山隱居，為了方便妻子上下山，花四十年親手開鑿數千級的「愛情天梯」。一九三四年，苗天領導村民種植名貴藥材，把藥材運到廣州售賣。新月兒子思行因門牙脫落久未長出新牙，被同學取笑不肯上學。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#170粵
programme.desc: 麗聽到亨的表白，大驚逃走，向眾人表示她要勇敢地根治與亨的問題。麗提出以「預習拍拖」之法，令她和亨之間熟習拍拖後的生活。原來高麗此舉的目的是令亨利死心，因此她提出多番無理要求，並以分手威脅要亨利完成。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#15粵普PG
programme.desc: 洪七公身體逐漸虛弱，決定將幫主之位傳給黃蓉…黃蓉想出計謀，讓歐陽克被巨石壓住；此時歐陽鋒和郭靖來到島上，歐陽鋒以洪七公作威脅，要郭靖和黃蓉救歐陽克…歐陽克在生死關頭向歐陽鋒求證一個關於自己身世的聽聞…

programme.title: 我是小廚神-新加坡篇粵普
programme.desc: 今集是分組賽，二人一組完成三道指定娘惹菜式。Antonia的母親是娘惹菜專家，佔盡優勢，卻與隊友Brendan爭拗連連；Joshua將領導位置讓給Onaya，發揮高超烹調技巧，獲主持大讚；Leonika、Tebo一凹一凸，相處融洽，互相信任，可是當Tebo切傷手指，Leonika為何未有理會？評判宋熙年、周凱韻、楊國基在雞蛋內挑骨頭，讓參賽者尋找進步空間，未能晉級的二人犯了甚麼大錯？

programme.desc: 舊同學阿融要邀請花出席舊生聚會。義卻看中花的舊同學群，應有不少富家子弟，正是他推銷保險的最佳時機，於是自薦成為花的舞伴。眾人大表贊成，眾女士更越俎代庖，為花準備舞會的「戰衣」，根本沒有理會花的感覺。

programme.desc: 六號拿起菜檔的紫芯淮山把玩，結果肥媽要炮製「紫淮山雞煲」來「執手尾」。食過海金友魚的朋友，可有想過用南瓜、花奶煮出「黃金海金友」？肥媽以生筋、豆卜炮製「油豆腐粉絲湯」，還教大家做「藍莓無芝士蛋糕」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 睡眠窒息症是一種常見睡眠障礙，患者睡覺時會因上呼吸道變窄，而導致反覆出現窒息或半窒息，增加罹患高血壓、糖尿病等疾病風險。家庭醫學專科醫生詳析睡眠窒息症的三大類別，並細說如何透過睡眠測試評估病情，並帶來治療資訊。遺囑與持久授權書是最常需要醫生評估並親自見證的法律文件，律師講解二者分別，以及訂立時的注意事項。腦神經外科醫生則述說為患者做評估的相關細節。「睇餸食飯」，許美德師傅示範「潮州蠔烙拼炸銀魚」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 斧頭扒深受肉食者喜愛，往深圳叫一個雙人餐，斧頭扒盡情撕吃兼副食放題！三人同行的話，加選鵝肝牛小排，CP值亦高。珠海某間在水中央的玻璃屋小店，日系風情配上充滿禪意的「藝術甜品」，秀怡還預約好幾款隱藏甜點，驚喜連連。香港有間百年老字號餐廳，在商場開設年輕版分店，菜式將傳統與新派融合，濃味之餘亦喚出兩代人的溫情與幸福感；再到另一個商場的日式食肆享用廚師發辦，海膽、豆腐、蟹膏同時放進嘴裡，口感有多豐富？

programme.title: 天梯#2粵
programme.desc: 美娟要新月接手當家之職，但她拒絕，美娟懷疑自己時日無多。廣達發現賀正堂大查櫃賀坤堯從中食價，最終無法把藥材賣出，苗天只好硬著頭皮求賀正堂，豈料二查櫃，即坤堯的兒子世豪肆意侮辱，鄭嬌忍無可忍出手打世豪。

programme.desc: 山田扮鬼臉逗得大家笑成一團，回家後更拿來火男面具助陣，小丸子家中沒面具，於是嘗試自行製作。小丸子嘗試把蜜瓜籽拿去種，小衫待種子發芽後討了部分蜜瓜苗回去種，並把小丸子視為親密好友。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 橋咀洲位於香港東面，屬於世界地質公園的一部份，島上因火山爆發而形成的「菠蘿包石」，歷史竟可追溯至一億年前！橋咀洲附近海域還孕育了豐富的海洋生態，更有大量珊瑚聚居。對於有意下水探索這神奇海洋世界的遊客，海洋保育專家提醒要注意的事項。不過，大批慕名而來的遊人，卻可能對島上與周邊水域的生態造成負擔。嘉賓所屬的環保團體，會向到訪橋咀洲的遊客宣揚保育訊息，另呼籲大家緊記「自己垃圾，自己帶走」。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 細菌人發現芝士狗正準備與奶酪狗約會，便出手妨礙，令奶酪狗迷路，更假扮奶酪狗芝士狗見面。細菌人在雪祭的場地搗亂時，被鰹魚節人擊退了。之後心有不甘的細菌人，以謊言煽動雪鬼攻擊鰹魚節人。

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#13粵
programme.desc: 范特栖口甜舌滑，在公司備受厚待，惹來文謙等人不滿。農曆七月十四當天，殯儀公司委託跨世代為其宣傳，萬里與楊帆爭相負責該項目。該公司負責人要求二人各自提交計劃書，再作決定。萬里與楊帆需外出處理事務，范特栖答應楊帆留守辦公室趕工，獨力完成計劃書；文謙等人為免被認為偷懶，遂不敢回家工作，只好留下加班。入夜後，文謙提起有關辦公室的恐怖傳聞，碧池發現范特栖似乎生性怕鬼，眾人遂設法嚇唬他。范特栖接連遭遇怪事……

programme.desc: 雪文、繼威婚禮上，雪文安排由特約演員扮演「媽媽」，詎料……雪文認定是幸如暗裡策劃要破壞婚禮，遷怒於幸如……熙妍酒醉時情不自禁親吻浩恩，隨後驚覺自己對浩恩有意。熙妍怕自己會成為「小三」背叛幸如，迴避浩恩。幸如於覆診時遇見婉蘭，更得知婉蘭的不幸近況。曉彤想安排家謙加入泰國渡假村小組，以爭取更大權力，但被啟榮、哲朗連成一線打壓；曉彤遂使計反擊啟榮……

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#23粵普PG
programme.desc: 包子出師，許母擔心被取代，許父趕來酒店與紀封交涉，最終紀封同意支付20萬，但要求他們用這筆錢幫蜜語還債。芷純向蜜語坦言自己試圖與紀封復合但被拒絕，勸她不要錯過當下，蜜語深受感動，決定勇敢面對自己的感情。

programme.desc: 定垚漸得董事信任，啟堂擔心地位不保，暗中將她的鐵丸換成抗抑鬱藥。程凱攙扶不適的定垚，巧遇澤雨及明晞，澤雨以為二人拍拖。啟堂想將十二生肖像擺放在會議室，獨欠的龍像由高哲投得，高哲卻在他面前把龍像打破，啟堂氣極。啟堂誣衊定垚有精神病，父女決裂。定垚重新與高哲合作發展能源項目，惹程凱不滿。明晞得知天生早有離婚安排感痛心，繼而受思琪的氣更氣憤，幸得澤雨為她出頭。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 睡眠窒息症是一種常見睡眠障礙，患者睡覺時會因上呼吸道變窄，而導致反覆出現窒息或半窒息，增加罹患高血壓、糖尿病等疾病風險。家庭醫學專科醫生詳析睡眠窒息症的三大類別，並細說如何透過睡眠測試評估病情，並帶來治療資訊。遺囑與持久授權書是最常需要醫生評估並親自見證的法律文件，律師講解二者分別，以及訂立時的注意事項。腦神經外科醫生則述說為患者做評估的相關細節。「睇餸食飯」，許美德師傅示範「潮州蠔烙拼炸銀魚」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 斧頭扒深受肉食者喜愛，往深圳叫一個雙人餐，斧頭扒盡情撕吃兼副食放題！三人同行的話，加選鵝肝牛小排，CP值亦高。珠海某間在水中央的玻璃屋小店，日系風情配上充滿禪意的「藝術甜品」，秀怡還預約好幾款隱藏甜點，驚喜連連。香港有間百年老字號餐廳，在商場開設年輕版分店，菜式將傳統與新派融合，濃味之餘亦喚出兩代人的溫情與幸福感；再到另一個商場的日式食肆享用廚師發辦，海膽、豆腐、蟹膏同時放進嘴裡，口感有多豐富？

programme.title: 天梯#2粵
programme.desc: 美娟要新月接手當家之職，但她拒絕，美娟懷疑自己時日無多。廣達發現賀正堂大查櫃賀坤堯從中食價，最終無法把藥材賣出，苗天只好硬著頭皮求賀正堂，豈料二查櫃，即坤堯的兒子世豪肆意侮辱，鄭嬌忍無可忍出手打世豪。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#171粵
programme.desc: 舊同學阿融要邀請花出席舊生聚會。義卻看中花的舊同學群，應有不少富家子弟，正是他推銷保險的最佳時機，於是自薦成為花的舞伴。眾人大表贊成，眾女士更越俎代庖，為花準備舞會的「戰衣」，根本沒有理會花的感覺。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#16粵普
programme.desc: 郭靖和黃蓉利用竹排挪開巨石，歐陽鋒救出歐陽克。之後歐陽鋒以洪七公要脅郭靖默寫九陰真經，又要求他砍樹造船。黃蓉和郭靖帶著洪七公乘木筏離開，途中遇上風浪，三人看到前方有大船便呼救，怎料竟遇上完顏洪烈等人。

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 黃凱芹從加拿大遠道而來，深情演繹經典情歌，並與二胡名家王憓中西樂cross over、請結他高手蘇德華「jam」一首<忘盡心中情。他還演唱「四大天王」經典金曲、與秋官及Liza姐合唱歌曲。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

高朋滿座#172粵
programme.desc: 義發現三妗婆強拉花與別人「相睇」，相親對象是「頭油阿叔」阿華。義在家中說出此事，令眾人擔心花的終生幸福。喜到廟內拜神時，得悉花並非三妗婆的親生女兒；眾人都擔心這名養母會出賣「女兒」的終生幸福。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#17粵普PG
programme.desc: 歐陽鋒懷疑郭靖給的是假的《九陰真經》，黃蓉聲稱能替他翻譯，要求一餐換翻譯一頁經文；周伯通突然空降船上救走黃蓉等人後就來到牛家村，在酒館內發現傻姑，而傻姑竟然會桃花島的武功，而後在密室發現曲靈風的屍骨…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽用水果入饌出神入化，由教切大樹菠蘿講起，用豬尾骨、蜜棗、陳皮烹調「大樹菠蘿湯」；又買來紅毛榴槤炮製雪糕。她以韓式調味料開芡煮牛肋條，事前選用雪梨蓉來醃，有何功用？還有一道用木煙熏的「豉油王熏雞」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 來到網紅追捧的珠海文化區，享用擺盤精緻的花花主題套餐，閨密們打卡慶生好去處！深圳熱賣椰子雞火鍋，鮮味雞件與清甜椰青湯底可謂絕配；臘味煲仔飯也是暖胃之選。超市有售雪藏貓山王果肉、榴槤薄餅，榴槤控為你「試伏」。回港搜羅「吃貨」優惠情報，日式居酒屋的蟹宴二人餐可嚐盡松葉蟹、皇帝蟹、鱈場蟹滋味，甲羅燒釜飯更是啖啖蟹膏，勁滿足！鬧市中隱藏「森系玻璃屋」，特色套餐匯聚十道亞洲風味，讓人在田園氛圍下忙裡偷閒。

programme.title: 天梯#3粵
programme.desc: 鄭嬌因出手打世豪被捕，世豪傷勢惡化，鄭嬌再次被扣留，苗天成功要脅坤堯放過鄭嬌。世章欲揭發坤堯所做不法之事，卻被坤堯輕易脫身，坤堯反指世章不尊重他，聲言要請假十天。苗天與鄭嬌發現所有藥材均發霉。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 時下流行穿熱褲，丸尾媽媽其實一直嚮往穿熱褲，但在家中試穿時卻被丸尾看到，後者大感震驚。爺爺打算丟掉沒用的舊物，小丸子助他分類後，爺爺卻表示不捨得丟，嫲嫲指出舊物是打開記憶的鎖匙。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 兒童體適能教練主理「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，小朋友準備好了嗎？雙腳踏穩，用手指做訓練。左手「L」字，右手「1」字，雙手不停互換；試試做「雙V」手勢並併合成「W」字，再分開雙手做出「L」字，可考驗協調度與全身肌力。再進一步，連雙腳都要跟着指令做！運用膠紙在地上貼一條直線，沿着線向前行之餘，再先後做出「開合跳」、「側身踏步」、「交叉跳」、「跳躍後蹲下」的動作，是一套講求心肺及協調能力的鍛練。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 花騎士・真誠的出現，令公主意識到愛麗絲比亞有新的敵人。到底新敵人是何方神聖？懷著什麼目的？公主們都百思不得其解。適逢今天是奈津的演唱會，這個大家等待已久的盛事，終究也避不過敵人的魔爪。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
programme.desc: 香港人頭腦靈活，經常有創新意念，事實上香港有很多不出名的發明，亦有很多不出名的發明家，當中有幾多會成功呢？新聞掏寶和大家重溫2004年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 東張西望粵 及 2026香港小姐 敢．至完美粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#14粵
programme.desc: 嘉冰認出電視台歌唱比賽「當年好聲音」上屆冠軍原是其手下敗將，她當年曾勝出業餘歌唱比賽，因父親反對未能投身歌壇。另一方面，萬里不滿嘉冰蠶食其生活，再度設法逼她離開。萬里的舊客戴志昌轉投楊帆旗下，贊助新一屆「當年好聲音」，打算安排冠軍唱出其廣告歌，卻不滿楊帆提交的歌曲。萬里獲安排協助宣傳，伺機奪回志昌這位大客……萬里設法誘嘉冰返回加拿大，卻觸及其傷心事，令她負氣離去。最終，嘉冰回來宣佈一個驚人決定……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#19粵
programme.desc: 曉彤成功使啟榮批准家謙加入渡假村小組。幸如等人與浩恩拍攝家電廣告，熙妍看着浩恩、幸如互動感不是味兒。熙妍得知幸如、浩恩被惡霸擄走，焦急帶人營救……啟榮、哲朗忌憚曉彤、家謙聯盟，哲朗吩咐助手Edmond找出曉彤的黑材料。繼威等人籌備新廣告，繼威被青春模特兒Emma吸引，雪文妒忌。雪文與佩貞的婆媳糾紛愈演愈烈，繼威煩惱不已。這時繼威與Emma不期而遇，似乎對上了眼……

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#24粵普
programme.desc: 蜜語調職到銷售部後，沒有發揮機會；寄舟畫展在香港洽談期間出現問題，蜜語趁機遊說他在浦榮舉辦，紀封由反對到支持舉辦畫展；錢迅趁機想要除去紀封；一切本來安排得非常妥當，展出前蜜語發現最重要的主展品不見了…

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Slim益生菌呈獻：南美潮什麼2粵
programme.desc: 來到哥國卡塔赫納附近小鎮，不可錯過托圖莫火山泥漿浴，還有專人按摩服務，好歎！被納入世遺的卡塔赫納舊城區，保留了殖民時期建築與城牆古蹟，舊式住宅大門還裝有不同動物門環，象徵甚麼意思？小社區搖身一變藝術蒲點，街頭壁畫隨處可見，打卡一流！遊沿海城市必嚐鮮，先試平民熱捧炸魚，再吃醃魚料理、海鮮燴飯。芷珮也慕名到咖啡店，品味冠軍級咖啡，有手信可將咖啡搽上身？登上「海盜船」出海吹風，在夕陽映照下享受悠閒時光！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

再創世紀#32粵PG
programme.desc: 明晞與澤雨到德國公幹，澤雨提議明晞放假，並帶她遊覽布拉格。澤雨在歌劇院門外巧遇定垚，二人重拾當日感覺，相約同遊時，卻被明晞暗中破壞。天生保釋回家，高哲預感天生及啟堂會有所動作，果然對方比他們早一步召開超級電池記者會，並命名為「烏托邦計劃」，程凱氣憤指責二人偷去他的設計概念。明晞被蒙在鼓裡，對天生失望。天生感到明晞與澤雨有曖昧，夫妻攤牌。天生邀請天蔭加入烏托邦計劃，澤雨拒絕，天生的一番話卻令他動搖。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#17粵普PG
programme.desc: 歐陽鋒懷疑郭靖給的是假的《九陰真經》，黃蓉聲稱能替他翻譯，要求一餐換翻譯一頁經文；周伯通突然空降船上救走黃蓉等人後就來到牛家村，在酒館內發現傻姑，而傻姑竟然會桃花島的武功，而後在密室發現曲靈風的屍骨…

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 「巨聲幫」林欣彤、陳慧敏決戰「兄弟幫」范振鋒、林盛斌。在波爾多，馬球有新玩法，猜猜會以甚麼取代馬匹？Do姐大方讓眾人提問，卻被阿范氣得呼其「鋒哥」，究竟發生何事？鄺潔楹帶大家參觀東京特色酒店，房內的蛋形物件大有用途！去旅行，當然要認識當地文化，法國人喝酒時有指定動作，關乎會否「行衰運」！兩位兄弟在答題板以「Jump」代「斟」，搞乜東東？兌換環節，慧敏賽前曾得方力申提供「貼士」，可會信錯人？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 黃翠如與陸浩明（6號）接受Do姐的問題大考驗，6號於看片前還拿「肥媽」來創作口號，現場反應卻不似預期。韓國的濟州盛產綠茶，在火山爆發形成的洞穴咖啡店內，還有特別的綠茶體驗？曼谷的非一般停車位，有何條件方能使用？周星馳的電影告訴大家，不可單憑外表判斷物品的用途。「問題專員」鄺潔楹在東京找來幾可亂真的「煙肉露筍卷」，其「真身」是……有嘉賓的二千積分最終價值不足一港元，到底兌換期間發生了甚麼事？

programme.title: 奇怪妙妙屋S2

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 青春時代
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 青春時代

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳(完)
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產(完)
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 青春時代

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

La patrulla de antimateria entra en contacto con el cloro y les propone proporcionarles rifles para dominar al sodio y así obligarlos a molecularizarse, pero Chip se burla de la antimateria y logra que el cloro y el sodio dejen de ser enemigos, restableciendo la paz en el mundo submarino.

Pero cuando el viento amaina, Chip idea una estrategia y deja a la antimateria encerrada en el molino, mientras él y los átomos siguen adelante.

programme.desc: Glitch wants to ski, so the Grimbots give Table Mountain a snowy peak, which threatens its rare plants.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - Your Brother is Really Naughty

After his eye test, Jaxon is struggling to decide which glasses he would like to wear. JoJo really wanted to pick new glasses too, but she doesn't need them. Gran Gran has a plan: JoJo can help Jaxon pick his new glasses!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Wish Badge

programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say bus and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different buses - red, double-decker and bendy! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Mr Monkeyjocks
programme.desc: Dad thinks the kids have too many toys and suggests a chuck out. To save their beloved Mr Monkeyjocks from getting the chop, Bluey and Bingo must prove he is special.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Magic

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Chest

Duggee was a great dancer, but he never stuck to the choreography and was always making up his own moves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - Betty's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun playing games but are surprised to find out that Betty didn't always enjoy playing. Since her first day at Squirrel Club, she always impressed everyone with her confidence and independence, but at first she didn't know how to join in with the others. Luckily, Duggee had a great idea to bring all the Squirrels together.

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa­Laa and Po receive a call on the Tubby Phone. It's the Tiddlytubbies who ring to say hello, just before the Tubby Phone Dance.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan…

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, & colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiancé so as to drive away two women whom he does not like…

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her master's family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her master's family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case…

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after a Qing army attack, but suffers serious injuries while fleeing. Mistaking Hong for a dangerous outlaw, Fang captures him and hands him over to the Qing soldiers. After learning the truth, Fang does everything he can to rescue Hong, so the two can join forces against the Qing army.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang’s custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society’s conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the other’s mole.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom. Later, Ying discovers that she is pregnant but no one can remember

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.desc: Olivia is assigned to do a school project based on one of the planets in the solar system, but they're all so interesting, she just can't decide which one! programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Goes To The Beach
programme.desc: When Grandma takes Olivia and Ian to a special beach, they're all shocked to find that Grandma's old friend Annette has built a huge fence blocking the best part of the beach. They don't let that stop them from having a good time. Soon with Olivia's prompting, even Annette wants to join in on the fun.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia's Snow Day
programme.desc: It's a snow day and school's closed. Olivia takes to the snow-covered streets with Julian as her cameraman, to report on all the snow day happenings. The biggest story of the day turns out to be an alleged sighting of the legendary abominable snowman. Can it be true? Olivia tracks down the real story.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia's Ice Spectacular
programme.desc: Olivia can't wait to see skating star Sonja Spencer perform in “Cinderella on Ice.” She's sure she'll be the lucky audience member chosen to skate with Sonja, and begins practicing on the skating rink she makes in her own backyard. When the show is canceled, Olivia decides the show must go on and she and her friends stage their own ice spectacular.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Itty Bitty Blossom
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a special plant called an Itty Bitty Blossom that goes from newborn to full-grown in one day. Gabby and Pandy have to take care of the whiny and fussy growing Itty Bitty Blossom and make sure it is in its permanent soil spot before it's fully grown.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Flying High Nest Sweet Nest
programme.desc: Marcus makes a Dew Drop-sized hot-air balloon for Phoebe and the Dews have a blast helping their kids from above, including secretly guiding Lola back to her family, before she accidentally follows Hip-Hop the frog out of the park. Phoebe makes a pair of glasses for Bob the bird, but when seeing things clearly for the first time gets him lost, the Dews help Bob find his nest before his family arrives for a visit.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Level Up Reed and the Beanstalk
programme.desc: The Dews think a double rainbow is making their powers change, but what they discover is that they are about to graduate to a new level of Dew Dropness, with the newfound ability to float in the air! When Reed discovers he’s being assigned a family, he runs to tell Athena, only to find Athena and her house are missing! While Eden and Phoebe search for Athena, Reed’s on Dew Drop duty for Athena. After successfully helping Athena's kids, Reed is assigned the family in the apartment below Athena.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Let's Make A Movie!
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes two little containers of popcorn and two movie tickets, it’s movie night in the dollhouse! Demanding Director CatRat leads the Gabby Cats through a Gabby-fied version of a classic story, Gabby-locks and the Three Bears.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Pete The Polar Bear
programme.desc: Pete the Polar Bear shows up for a vacation on MerCat’s sunny beach. Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats show Pete he can have a great vacation, even if things don’t go precisely to plan.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - A Frog-let Tale
programme.desc: Lala, who's grown into a froglet, is ready to finally join the gang on a big adventure in the city! But she relies on her water bowl to get around, and Gloria goes overboard in trying to protect her tiny friend in the big world- only to realize that she underestimated all Lala is capable of doing.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Snow Day
programme.desc: When a snowstorm blocks Kate from accessing the zoo, Melman decides to become “substitute Kate” and make sure the animals are cared for. But when the animals go wild in the snow, Melman’s future-paramedic skills are put to the test during an outbreak of stubbed toes and boo-boos. A series of stumbles makes Melman question whether he’s cut out to be a paramedic--until he learns that mastering a goal takes grit!

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Berry Race The Artist
programme.desc: The kids have a race to decide who gets to try some extremely rare berries. When Scallop finds a beautiful and mysterious sea sculpture, she enlists the help of her friends to search the sea for the artist behind the masterpiece.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Winkly Fest Snow
programme.desc: When Pixie struggles to recreate an old tradition perfectly, the kids realize they can make their own traditions. A story told by Chef J inspires Juniper to go in search of snow.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - The Pawston Chewbilee Don’t Go, Cat. Go!
programme.desc: Based on PD Eastman's classic children’s book, Go, Dog. Go! Follows 6-year-old dog, Tag Barker, on her hilarious adventures in the city of Pawston, a fun-loving community of dogs on the go. Tag is a skilled mechanic and loves anything that goes. With her ingenuity and creativity, Tag can go as far as any plan will take her, always with her best friend, Scooch Pooch, by her side. Scooch’s easy-going nature is the perfect counterbalance to Tag’s high-octane energy. But as much as Tag loves to go,

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Snow Dog, Snow!
programme.desc: When Tag and Scooch learn that Sandra Paws' sleigh broke down on a mountain, they have to go on an adventure to fix the sleigh and save Sniffs-mas! Meanwhile, Beans tries to get a grumpy Frank to feel the Sniffs-mas spirit.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Lost and Found In the Park In the Dark
programme.desc: The Community Center's Lost and Found is full and it's up to the gang to use their detective skills and return the lost items to their original owners. Rodney only needs one more bird on his birdwatching list, but the only problem is that it only comes out at night! Team Zenko must help Rodney face his fear of the dark so he can get the last picture for his collection.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Longest Yardwork The Girl Who Cried Goose
programme.desc: Donna plans a garden party for Rona, but the only problem is that her garden is overgrown and neglected. The team try to transform this jungle into a backyard just in time for the party. Lula finds an angry goose on the loose, and Team Zenko need to get it out of the park before soccer camp starts.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - King Burple
programme.desc: After Burple and Cutter crash-land in a village of tiny dragons, Burple's unintentional act of courage leads the locals to crown him as their king.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Charged Up
programme.desc: Magnus's superpowered mechano-dragon threatens to replace the Riders. But when it spirals out of control, the town's real heroes have to step up!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - A Knight's Tail
programme.desc: Huzzah! Gabby the Bold and Pandy the Purr-owd are Knights in Training, and they head into the dollhouse for the Royal Knighting Ceremony. But it turns out that someone's locked King Catnip in the tower and without him they'll have to cancel the Royal Knighting Ceremony! It's up to the Knights in Training to solve the mystery and save King Catnip by performing acts of knighthood. For our Cat of the Day, Pandy makes a shield craft!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ's Glow Ride
programme.desc: Gabby receives a special nighttime delivery, unboxing a glow-in-the-dark train engine. However, she realizes that she's missing the other three train cars to complete the whole train. The Gabby Cats help Gabby build the other three glow-in-the-dark train cars by creating shapes through interactivemusical games. In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, DJ Catnip sings a song.

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S1 - Two TwigsFresh Coat of Pain
programme.desc: The Mighty Ones can't tell the difference between Twig and a random stick bug. Rocksy sees fresh coat of paint spilled all over and becomes obsessed with trying to freshen up the yard.

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S1 - A Stinky Situation Fire-Fly
programme.desc: When Twig gets sprayed by a skunk trying to save his friends, the Mighty Ones agree not to ruin his hero moment by telling him that the stinks. Instead, they try to wash the smell off of him without him knowing. programme.desc: After a trip to the planetarium, Ian's knowledge about space and his peculiar behaviour lead Olivia to believe that her brother is an alien. Olivia soon discovers his secret…he's making a special gift for his favourite sister

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Plants A Garden
programme.desc: When Mrs. Hogenmuller distributes seeds for a class garden project, Olivia just can't wait for her plants to grow. But when her dog Perry digs up her little garden, Olivia discovers something even more exciting – what appears to be a dinosaur bone!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy's Sleepover
programme.desc: When Gabby, Pandy and the Gabby Cats prepare for a sleepover in the Garden, they discover Pillow Cat has never been to a sleepover. They help her conquer her fears and enjoy her first sleepover.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Banana Bread Burglar Finding Meow Meow
programme.desc: When the banana bread Harper leaves out for Eden is stolen, the Dew Drops create a sting operation to catch the thief. When Captain Meow Meow gets a splinter in his paw and hears the word "vet," he flees. Now it's up to the Dew Drops to find Captain Meow Meow and get that splinter out.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Catch that Drone The Fairy of the Teeth
programme.desc: When Harper's drone flies away it’s up to the Dew Drops to get it back. And while Eden wishes she could fly like a drone, she learns that she can do great things with or without wings. When Dylan loses his first tooth the Dew Drops learn that the Tooth Fairy will be coming and Athena tries so hard to make a good impression that she almost ruins Dylan's first lost tooth experience.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Pandy's Birthday
programme.desc: It’s Pandy’s birthday!! The dollhouse is throwing a surprise party for him! Gabby goes room to room preparing all his favorite things for the party, but when the big moment comes, Pandy drops his cake! Gabby consoles him and tells him it’s even better – now, they have smash cake! They all hold up a piece and pose for a picture.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - The Dollhouse Hotel
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a suitcase and a hotel brochure, it’s time to take a trip to The Dollhouse Hotel! Hotel guests Gabby and Pandy check in with the Hotel Manager DJ Catnip then go to Mercat’s Spa and even order room service from Pillow Cat! For our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Pillow Cat sings a song!

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Melman at the Movies
programme.desc: Melman finds a lucky flower and is convinced that today will be his Best Day Ever! But when a series of unlucky events threaten to ruin his day, he’s faced with the choice to drown in his sorrows or “take back the day”!

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Everybody Loves a (Sea) Lion
programme.desc: When the happy-go-lucky sea lions draw crowds away from his show, Alex decides that he needs to act like the Sea Lions. When Alex’s attempts to compete with them don’t bring back the crowds, he learns to be true to himself rather than try to be someone he's not (i.e. fish gotta swim, birds gotta fly, and lions gotta roar... and do backflips on land).

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - She Said, She Said Starfish
programme.desc: When one of Rikki’s plants won't sing, Pixie and Juniper both tell their varying recollections of why the plant is suddenly silent. Kelp, Scallop, and Cruz have always thought that starfish did nothing but laze about; but as they go about their day, the starfish goes through his own routine, completely unbeknownst to everyone else.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Leroy’s Caterpillar Lost Spark
programme.desc: Leroy must learn to let go when his caterpillar friend turns into a butterfly. When Pixie loses her spark, Kelp and Juniper look for the plant they think will cure her. Meanwhile Pixie wonders whether she can be cured at all!

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Old Dog, New Tricks \ Snoozie-Hullabaloozie
programme.desc: Tag chooses to pair up with her Grandpaw for the Barker Family Talent Show, and together, they search for their winning talent. \ Tag is surprised to learn that today is the Pawston Snoozie-a-Hullabaloozie. With everything shut down for the day, Tag and Scooch take the opportunity to play all over town, while trying not to wake up other dogs.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Show Dog, Show \ Keys to Victory
programme.desc: Tag can't wait to show off her car at the car show. But when Cheddar Biscuit wants to come along and pick up her clown friends along the way, Tag is wary that Cheddar Biscuit will steal her thunder. \ The Not Yet Cadets can't wait to watch Sam’s big race. But when Sam loses his car key, he challenges the Not Yet Cadets to race around town to find it.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Photo Day Disaster The Eightful Eight
programme.desc: When Rodney heads to the Community Center for Junior Security Cadet picture day, TZG secretly helps him stay neat and clean for the photo shoot. When Luis worries about his first ever math test, TZG secretly helps steady his nerves.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Robo-Dog Day Afternoon Spoiler Alert
programme.desc: New girl in town Felicia shows off her robo-dog but it runs out of control, and TZG must secretly stop the barking bot from wreaking havoc. When Lula starts gathering birthday wishes from folks around town, TZG secretly keeps her surprise party under wraps.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - The Nest
programme.desc: When the Rescue Riders save Viking chief Duggard, they’re invited to visit his village of Huttsgalor, where they must prove they're kind and helpful.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Dak's lack of planning gets him, Cutter and Winger lost with Elbone in the Maze Caves, and Leyla's overthinking threatens the effort to rescue them.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back
programme.desc: Gabby brings DJ Catnip a microphone for him to use in the big music show, but he has some terrible news: he lost his groove! Determined to help him get his groove back, Gabby and Pandy take him on a musical search through the dollhouse. As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats’ everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Gabby sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy Gets Sick
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a recipe for dandelion soup and a soup bowl, she discovers Kitty Fairy is sick! Gabby and Pandy make her some delicious dandelion soup and while she rests, they take care of her Garden. With the help of all the Gabby Cats, they water the Singing Flowers, help the Rainbow Kitty Bushes regain their color, and sing some fussy Itty Bitty Blossoms a lullaby. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song!

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S1 - Unintended BunnynessBerry's Pet Threat
programme.desc: Twig accidentally discovers Easter when he gets covered in dryer lint, which makes him look like a bunny while coincidentally stumbling onto a group of hapless eggs that need to be protected from predators. When Berry forms a close bond with a crow that follows her around like a pet, Rocksy tries to convince Berry that it's only following her around because it's trying to eat her.

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S1 - Shiny LeafRoundy
programme.desc: Leaf freaks out when he finds a blemish on his butt before a body building competition and Twig tries desperately to snap him out of his existential crisis. Berry gets jealous when Rocksy starts spending all of her time with a marble, and tries various attempts to make the marble "disappear."

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S2 - Ugly Duckling
programme.desc: As Puss readies a team to defend San Lorenzo, he's shocked to discover his mentor El Guante Blanco has taken on the Ugly Ducking as his newest protégé.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S2 - The Muscle
programme.desc: When traveling to recruit the mighty Golem for their mission, Puss tries to prove that no one is better than him at being "the muscle" of the team.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Price Of Freedom
programme.desc: Grayson wrangles Spirit "fair and square" and sends him to auction in another town --and there is nothing Lucky can do to stop him!

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Long Way Home
programme.desc: Spirit and Lucky desperately try to find a way back to one another.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - Race To The Finish Part 1
programme.desc: The girls get summer jobs to help Lucky repair the sprawling house she inherited from her grandfather near the Rosemead Valley Racetrack.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - Race To The Finish Part 2
programme.desc: Determined to save her family home, Lucky signs up to race as a wild card in Rosemead's elite Junior Cup. But winning it all won't be easy.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Scent of a Dragon
programme.desc: Tom and the riders must work together to rescue Eugene from a dragon’s nest.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Sting It On!
programme.desc: Tom must rescue Olivia from the Hidden World when she winds up getting herself frozen by a pack of hungry Speed Stingers.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Deep Freeze
programme.desc: When a deep freeze puts the lives of everyone in Rakke Town in jeopardy, the riders must attempt to use the dragons to get the humans through the night without being seen.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Mega Fat
programme.desc: After Mega Fat is fired from Baby Corp;he’s forced on the path of recovery towards being a Good Baby. However;Mega Fat is more interested in getting revenge on Boss Baby than finding the perfect family to adopt him.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Halloween
programme.desc: Boss Baby uses the cover of Halloween Night to sneak into Bubeezee’s Headquarters to shut it all down. Tim covers for Boss by distracting Marisol with a night of trick or treating.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Who's a Good Baby?
programme.desc: A brainwashed Boss Baby breaks free from overly sanitized Bubbeezee products. He rallies the Playgroup Babies to run the company out of business by breaking every product in town.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Savage Spite of the Slimy Salamangler
programme.desc: Krupp's campers take on rich rivals in a hoity-toity boat race that also features a revenge-obsessed giant salamander. Paging Captain Underpants!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Cunning Combat of the Covert Camoflush
programme.desc: The campers' splat-tastic game of paintball is rather rudely interrupted by a foul and formidable fiend known only as Camoflush.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programme.desc: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - When Darkness Falls
programme.desc: On an island that will make the perfect outpost, the Dragon Riders discover its indigenous residents are a mysterious new breed of dragon.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Big Man On Berk
programme.desc: Thinking he's allergic to Meatlug, Fishlegs gets hypnotized – and wakes up transformed into an invincible warrior known as Thor Bonecrusher.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Gone Gustav Gone
programme.desc: When Dagur the Deranged captures Gustav, it's up to Hiccup, Toothless and the Dragon Riders to get him back.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Final Key
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere tells the kids that the failed mission is over, but Tony isn’t ready to give up, and he’s determined to rescue Frostee. The crew goes rogue by deciding to steal the final key from Shashi and trade it for their friend.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Ignition
programme.desc: Shashi finally reveals his master plan.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Key To The Strip
programme.desc: The kids battle Shashi in Las Vegas as Shashi tries to take down evil billionaire Cleve and use Skeleton Key to create a new world order. Frostee has a plan to get Skeleton Key offline, but it only gives Tony ten seconds to take Shashi out and save the world.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Master Key
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents—her mom. And somehow, Po finds himself in a chess tournament against the Queen of Englan

programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! programme.desc: When Jim and Toby investigate a Goblin attack, they discover Changelings are secretly living amongst them and rebuilding the Killahead Bridge!

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Win, Lose Or Draal
programme.desc: Everything comes into perspective when Jim discovers his re-match with Draal is to the death.

In this episode, he reflects on the moments that defined his Premier League career, from dazzling solo runs to spectacular strikes, that made him a true fan favourite.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP2
programme.desc: Extended sit-downs and more informal 'out and about' interview with the Premier League's biggest stars, providing players with a platform to tell their story in their own words.

programme.title: FANTASY SHOW - FRI 28 AUG
programme.desc: Haaland or Ekitike? Saka or Palmer? Cunha or Joao Pedro? Picking your Fantasy team is never easy, but the Fantasy Show is on hand to help FPL Managers with those big decisions.

programme.title: FANZONE - FRI 28 AUG
programme.desc: This is the show that puts international fans at the heart of the Premier League conversation. We connect with fans from around the world as they share their views on their teams and favourite players.

programme.title: PREVIEW - FRI 28 AUG
programme.desc: A tightly packed look-ahead to the forthcoming match round with a mix of player interviews and special features.

programme.title: WELCOME TO THE WEEKEND - FRI 28 AUG
programme.desc: Light-hearted, inclusive and entertaining, Welcome to the Weekend is the show that kicks off the Premier League Weekend. We will focus on the football, but also on the lifestyle topics that footballers and fans love – food, fashion, music, movies and much, much more.
